items.source: Serves as a superclass for more specific exceptions, for example, DuplicateKeyException. However, it is generally recommended to handle DataIntegrityViolationException itself instead of relying on specific exception subclasses.
items.translation: 作为更具体异常的超类，例如DuplicateKeyException。然而，通常建议直接处理DataIntegrityViolationException本身，而不是依赖特定的异常子类。

items.source: cause - the root cause from the data access API in use
items.translation: cause - 正在使用的数据访问 API 中的根本原因
